steps.label: Parcel record & Parcel ID
steps.description: The Property Appraiser's record for the parcel — its unique Parcel ID, owner, legal description, subdivision and (often) the deed & plat book/page. It's the anchor that identifies the property and seeds every other lookup.

steps.label: Property Appraiser / Tax record
steps.description: The county tax-roll record — owner, situs, use code, land & living area, just/assessed/taxable values and the last recorded sale (OR book/page). Used to confirm identity, size and the authoritative deed reference.

steps.label: Deed — subject parcel
steps.description: The recorded instrument that conveys ownership. It carries the record legal description the survey must retrace, plus the OR book/page reference.
